title: Atom Computing, one of the nine quantum computing startups backed by the US, raised a $100M Series C led by Third Point, bringing its total funding to $300M (Lucinda Shen/Axios)
summary: Lucinda Shen / Axios: Atom Computing, one of the nine quantum computing startups backed by the US, raised a $100M Series C led by Third Point, bringing its total funding to $300M — Quantum company Atom Computing raised a $100 million Series C led by Third Point Ventures, it tells Axios exclusively.
